title: Cable Modem
description: DOCSIS cable modem channels, SNR, power and event log from cablemodem-exporter

panels.title: Min DS SNR
panels.description: Worst SC-QAM channel right now. 256-QAM wants ≥33 dB.

panels.title: DS power spread
panels.description: Difference between hottest and weakest downstream channel; a large tilt suggests a cabling/splitter issue.

panels.title: Max US power
panels.description: Highest ATDMA transmit power. Above ~51 dBmV the modem is straining to reach the CMTS.

panels.title: Warnings in range
panels.description: Warning-or-worse modem log entries observed by the exporter during the selected range

panels.title: Downstream SNR per channel
panels.description: SNR/MER per locked SC-QAM channel. Red band <30 dB, orange 30–33 dB.

panels.title: Downstream power per channel
panels.description: Receive level per SC-QAM channel. Ideal −7…+7 dBmV; beyond ±15 the modem struggles.

panels.title: Upstream ATDMA transmit power
panels.description: Higher means more attenuation between modem and CMTS. ~38–48 dBmV is comfortable.

panels.title: Event rate by category
panels.description: New modem log entries per hour (a rolling rate, so one event spreads over a few bars). Best effort: entries that scroll out of the modem's ~20-line log between polls are never seen.

panels.title: Events in range by category
panels.description: New modem log entries seen during the selected time range (estimated from counter samples, like any increase())

panels.title: Modem event log
panels.description: Every log entry seen during the selected range, newest first. Needs the exporter's opt-in CM_EXPORT_EVENT_MESSAGES=true (one series per distinct log line). The exporter also writes every new entry to the systemd journal (journalctl -u cablemodem-exporter).

panels.title: Last successful poll
panels.description: Seconds since the exporter last read the modem successfully

panels.title: Exporter logins
panels.description: Logins the exporter made in this range. Each one writes a 'GUI Login' line to the modem's ~20-entry log, so this should stay near zero.

panels.title: Poll errors in range
panels.description: Failed polls during the selected time range, by cause
